description: Estimate embedding, vector-store and generator costs using an explicit embedding token rate and full monthly vector budget plus a supported generator model. Supplied rates remain scenario inputs; unresolved stored embedding or vector prices cannot silently supply the calculation.

embedding_cost_per_1m_tokens.description: Explicit embedding USD per 1M tokens; supply together with the full monthly vector-store budget. Used for initial corpus, reindex and query embeddings; not a verified vendor rate.

embedding_provider.description: Optional label for a supplied-rate scenario; a stored price requires its own source review.

reindex_fraction_per_month.description: Fraction of corpus re-embedded per month (default 0.1)

vector_store.description: Optional label for a supplied monthly budget; a stored price requires its own source review.

vector_store_monthly_cost_usd.description: Full monthly vector-store budget in USD, including minimums, storage, reads, writes and other applicable charges. No dimensions or vendor billing units are inferred.

name: rag-pipeline-cost-calculator
